# Nord

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-nord)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-nord)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-nord)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-nord)

Nord is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-nord codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `nord` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { nord } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-nord';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, nord],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `nord` | `Extension` |
| `nordMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#2e3440` |
| Active line | `#343b48` |
| Selection | `#40495b` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#96bbe9` | bold | 6.29:1 | 5.67:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#96bbe9` | bold | 6.29:1 | 5.67:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#d3accc` | - | 6.27:1 | 5.65:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#d8dee9` | - | 9.25:1 | 8.33:1 | 6.69:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#d8dee9` | - | 9.25:1 | 8.33:1 | 6.69:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#f1a58d` | - | 6.25:1 | 5.63:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#92c0be` | - | 6.25:1 | 5.63:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#88c0d0` | - | 6.24:1 | 5.63:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#ebcb8b` | - | 8.00:1 | 7.21:1 | 5.79:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#ebcb8b` | italic | 8.00:1 | 7.21:1 | 5.79:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#9abbdc` | italic | 6.25:1 | 5.64:1 | 4.53:1 |
| String | `string` | `#a5c08e` | - | 6.26:1 | 5.65:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#d3accc` | - | 6.27:1 | 5.65:1 | 4.54:1 |

| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#d8dee9` | - | 9.25:1 | 8.33:1 | 6.69:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#acb8cf` | italic | 6.25:1 | 5.64:1 | 4.53:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#d8dee9` | background, active line, selection | 6.69:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#acb8cf` | gutter | 7.21:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#d8dee9` | background, active line | 8.33:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#88c0d0` | background | 6.24:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #88c0d0` | background, active line | 5.63:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#9abbdc, 1px solid #92c0be` | background (fill or outline) | 6.25:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#40495b` | active line | 1.24:1 | Pass |
